title: Guided: send parcels in batches

ticket.subject: Batches of parcels
ticket.body: Give the parcel list in batches of a given size. Each batch holds 1 to size items, in order. An empty list gives no batches. A size below 1 is a mistake: raise ValueError.

rules: Each batch holds between 1 and size items, and the last batch may be shorter.
The items keep their order, both between batches and inside each batch.
An empty input gives no batches.
A size below 1 raises ValueError, as itertools.batched does.

title: Ticket: read a weight

ticket.subject: Scanner weights
ticket.body: The scanner sends weights as text. Return a float. Return None when the text is not a number, and also for nan and inf, which are not weights. Any other input is a bug, so it must still raise TypeError.

rules: Text such as " 4.5 " gives the float 4.5.
Text that is not a number gives None.
A value that is not text raises TypeError.
Text that reads as nan or inf gives None, because it is not a weight.

title: Guided: format a label

ticket.subject: Labels for the pallet board
ticket.body: Each pallet board line reads "name: count items". Trim spaces, tabs, and line breaks around the name.

rules: Return the name, then a colon, a space, the count, and the word items.
Remove whitespace from both ends of the name: spaces, tabs, and line breaks.

title: Ticket: save and reload the batch notes

ticket.subject: Batch notes on disk
ticket.body: Write each note on its own line to the file at the given path, then read the file back. Use a with block for each open file, so each file is closed before the next step.

rules: Each note is written on its own line, and the file ends with a line break after the last note.
Reading the file back gives the notes without their line breaks.
An empty list of notes gives an empty list back.
